items.title: For formally unramified composites of spaces with lci middle step the conormal transitivity sequence is short exact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given formally unramified Z -> Y -> X of algebraic spaces over S with Z -> Y a local complete intersection morphism, the six-term-right piece i^*C_{Y/X} -> C_{Z/X} -> C_{Z/Y} -> 0 of the transitivity lemma is short exact (the left map is injective). The retained proof reduces to schemes through a three-step surjective etale lift U -> X, V -> U x_X Y, W -> V x_Y Z; the universal-thickening-localize lemma makes W -> V and V -> U formally unramified, the conormal sequence restricts to the one of W -> V -> U, and the schemes case (More on Morphisms, transitivity-conormal-lci) applies because W -> V is lci by definition of lci for spaces. Retained author proof at lines 11472-11487.
